faqs.q: What are finned tube coils used for?
faqs.a: The Finned Tube Coils are used for air heating and cooling in process and HVAC plant, for heat recovery from exhaust and flue gas, and as steam, hot-water or thermal-oil heating coils in ducts. They are engineered to order from your duty and duct dimensions, not sold from a catalogue.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to quote a finned tube coil?
faqs.a: Send the duty (fluid, flow, temperatures and pressure), the coil type and dimensions or the drawing, the tube or pipe material, OD and wall, the fin type, material and spacing, the design code, test pressure and inspection, and the quantity and delivery point.

faqs.q: Do you have standard sizes of the Finned Tube Coils?
faqs.a: No. Each unit is designed to your data sheet or drawing, and the listing has no fixed size table. Coils are built to the duty and the space they go into.

faqs.q: How are tube and fin materials chosen for a finned coil?
faqs.a: The tube and fin are chosen together: copper or stainless tube with aluminium or copper fins for clean air, and steel tube with steel fins for hot or dirty gas. Fin spacing is opened up where the air carries dust, and coils can be galvanised or coated for coastal sites.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature ratings apply to the Finned Tube Coils?
faqs.a: The listing gives no fixed rating because each coil is designed to your duty and code. State the fluid, flow, temperatures, design pressure and test pressure on the enquiry and the design is quoted against them.

faqs.q: What materials can the Finned Tube Coils be built from?
faqs.a: Materials follow your specification: copper or stainless tube with aluminium or copper fins for clean air, steel tube with steel fins for hot or dirty gas, with galvanising or coating for coastal sites. The tube grade, bend radii and coil dimensions come from your drawing or our design.

faqs.q: Which codes and documents apply to the Finned Tube Coils?
faqs.a: Documentation, inspection and the test plan follow the code and specification you give us; the listing does not name one fixed code. Each coil is pressure tested and documented to the inspection and test plan before it ships.

faqs.q: What do I use finned tube coils with?
faqs.a: Finned coils sit in ducts and air heaters, and are related to the [Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles](/p/heat-exchanger-tube-bundles) and [Helical Pipe Coils](/p/helical-pipe-coils). The [tube bundles and coils shelf](/c/tube-bundles-coils) lists the other built-to-order items.

faqs.q: How are the Finned Tube Coils built and tested?
faqs.a: Bends are made to keep wall thinning and ovality inside the governing specification, welds are to qualified procedures, and each coil is pressure tested and documented before it ships. Say on the enquiry if third-party inspection is needed.

faqs.q: Where are finned tube coils used in the field?
faqs.a: Typical uses are air heaters and steam coils for air-cooled heat exchanger winterization, as well as process and HVAC air heating and cooling and heat recovery from exhaust and flue gas. See [our guide to finned tube types](/blog/types-of-finned-tubes) for the fin types behind them.

faqs.q: Can you export the Finned Tube Coils from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, Finned Tube Coils goes out of Dubai, UAE to export customers worldwide. Crating is agreed with the quotation. Tell us the destination port or country on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the shipping route with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Finned Tube Coils in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: We quote Finned Tube Coils from Dubai, UAE to your drawing or data sheet, as it is built for the job and not a stock item. Each coil is designed to your data sheet. Share the requirement on [our contact page](/contact) and the lead time comes back with the quotation.

faqs.q: What are replacement heat exchanger tube bundles used for?
faqs.a: The Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles are replacement and new tube bundles for shell-and-tube exchangers and air coolers, built from the original data sheet or a new design for turnaround retubing and bundle replacement. The shell and channel stay in place, the old bundle is pulled and the new one has to fit first time.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to quote a heat exchanger tube bundle?
faqs.a: Send the original data sheet or nameplate and the TEMA type. Then add the tube count, OD, wall, length, pitch and layout, the baffle type, cut and spacing, the tubesheet thickness and material, the bundle weight and lifting arrangement, and the materials. [Our air cooler bundle replacement data sheet guide](/blog/air-cooler-bundle-replacement-data-sheet) gives the checklist.

faqs.q: Do you have standard sizes of the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles?
faqs.a: No. Each unit is designed to your data sheet or drawing, with no fixed size table. A replacement bundle starts from the original data sheet, the nameplate or a survey of the old bundle.

faqs.q: Can a replacement bundle change the tube material or type?
faqs.a: Yes. Where the original tubes failed early, a change of tube material or wall, or a move to low-fin or twisted-tape tube, can be built into the new bundle at the same time. We match the tube count, size, pitch and layout, or redesign where the duty or materials have changed.

faqs.q: What design codes apply to the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles?
faqs.a: The listing names TEMA (R/C/B), API 660 9th ed. / ISO 16812, ASME VIII Div 1 / EN 13445 and PED 2014/68/EU. The design code on your order governs the materials, welding, testing and documents.

faqs.q: What materials are the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles built in?
faqs.a: Materials of the tubes, tube sheets and baffles follow your data sheet or specification, and are confirmed with the quotation. Tube sheets are drilled and grooved to TEMA, and tubes are expanded or welded to a qualified procedure.

faqs.q: What testing and documents come with the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles?
faqs.a: The bundle is hydrotested and documented before it ships, with documentation, inspection and the test plan to the order's code and specification. Say on the enquiry if third-party inspection is required.

faqs.q: What does the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles fit into?
faqs.a: A replacement bundle is built to slide into the existing shell and bolt to the existing channel. Related items are on the [tube bundles and coils shelf](/c/tube-bundles-coils), [heat exchangers](/c/heat-exchangers) and [boiler pressure parts](/c/boiler-pressure-parts), and tube sheets are on the [tube sheets shelf](/c/tube-sheets).

faqs.q: What should I watch when retubing a bundle?
faqs.a: Clean tube-hole grooves to bare metal before inserting new tubes, and avoid over-rolling, which weakens ligaments and distorts the tubesheet. Most bundle orders come in ahead of a turnaround, so allow time for drawing approval.

faqs.q: Where are replacement tube bundles used?
faqs.a: Typical jobs are gas-plant air-cooled exchanger re-tubing and refinery turnaround and inspection (T&I) bundle replacement, where the bundle must fit the existing shell first time.

faqs.q: Can you export the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles goes out of Dubai, UAE to export customers worldwide. Bundle weight and lifting arrangement are agreed with the order. Tell us the destination port or country on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the shipping route with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: We quote Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles from Dubai, UAE to your drawing or data sheet, as it is built for the job and not a stock item. Each bundle is built from your data sheet. Share the requirement on [our contact page](/contact) and the lead time comes back with the quotation.

faqs.q: What are helical pipe coils used for?
faqs.a: The Helical Pipe Coils are pipe and tube coiled into helices for heaters, tank coils and coil-wound exchangers, from carbon steel and alloy tube and pipe. They pack a long tube length into a small volume as tank and reactor heating and cooling coils, fired-heater and waste-heat coils.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to quote helical pipe coils?
faqs.a: Send the duty (fluid, flow, temperatures and pressure), the coil type and dimensions or the drawing, the tube or pipe material, OD and wall, the design code, test pressure and inspection, and the quantity and delivery point.

faqs.q: Do you have standard sizes of the Helical Pipe Coils?
faqs.a: No. Each coil is designed to your data sheet or drawing. The coil diameter, pitch and number of turns follow from the duty and the space.

faqs.q: How tight can a helical coil be bent?
faqs.a: The bend radius is kept large enough that wall thinning and ovality stay inside the tube specification, so the coil diameter and pitch come from the duty, the space and the tube size. State the OD, wall and available space on the enquiry.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Helical Pipe Coils have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no fixed rating because each coil is built to your design pressure and code. Send the pressure, temperature and test pressure on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Which tube grades are available for the Helical Pipe Coils?
faqs.a: Coils are formed from A106 B, A179, A192, A210, P235GH and EN 10216 grades, with stainless in another supply lane. Tell us the grade on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Helical Pipe Coils?
faqs.a: The listing names ASTM A106, A179, A192 and A210 / EN 10216-2 and EN 10216. Documentation, inspection and the test plan follow the code and specification on your order.

faqs.q: What do helical coils connect to?
faqs.a: They serve heater and tank coil systems and coil-wound exchangers; related items are the [Finned Tube Coils](/p/finned-tube-coils) and [Heat Exchanger Tube Bundles](/p/heat-exchanger-tube-bundles) on the [tube bundles and coils shelf](/c/tube-bundles-coils).

faqs.q: How are the Helical Pipe Coils built and tested?
faqs.a: Bends are made to keep wall thinning and ovality inside the governing specification, welds are to qualified procedures, and each coil is pressure tested and documented to the inspection plan before it ships.

faqs.q: Where are helical coils used?
faqs.a: Typical uses are heater coils, tank heating coils and process coolers, as well as reactor heating and cooling coils and waste-heat coils.

faqs.q: Can you export the Helical Pipe Coils from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Helical Pipe Coils from Dubai, UAE to buyers across the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Crating is agreed with the quotation. Give the destination and quantity on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the freight lane with the goods.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Helical Pipe Coils in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Helical Pipe Coils is quoted from Dubai, UAE against your drawing or data sheet rather than held as a standard item. Each coil is built to your data sheet. Send the details through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the lead time with the quotation.
